memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Patient presents with COPD, osteoporosis, and depressive symptoms.
He reports mild exertional dyspnea, occasional wheeze, back discomfort, and low mood over past month. On exam: respiratory rate 18, SpO2 94% room air, diffuse wheeze bilaterally, no cyanosis; thoracic spine tender, no deformity; affect slightly blunt. Spirometry: FEV1 1.38 L (55% predicted), FVC 2.45 L, FEV1/FVC 0.56; baseline. Asthma Control Test score 15 (not well controlled). Technique checked: correct for tiotropium Dry Powder inhaler. Smoking status: former, 22 pack-years, stopped 2010.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Tiotropium 18 mcg inhaler OD via Dry Powder device.
Salbutamol 100 mcg metered-dose inhaler SOS.
Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhaler BD.
Alendronate 70 mg PO once weekly.
Calcium carbonate 500 mg PO BD with cholecalciferol 400 IU.
Sertraline 50 mg PO OD.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum calcium 9.2 mg/dL (8.5-10.5).
Serum 25-OH vitamin D 22 ng/mL (30-100) – insufficient.
TSH 2.8 mIU/L (0.4-4.5).
Vitamin B12 340 pg/mL (200-900).

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-05-22 at 10:30 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Patient reports improved dyspnea on mild exertion, occasional nocturnal wheeze, back pain unchanged, mood slightly better.
Exam: SpO2 95%, mild wheeze at lung bases, no use of accessory muscles; lumbar tenderness persists.
Spirometry: FEV1 1.45 L (58% pred), FVC 2.50 L, FEV1/FVC 0.58; ΔFEV1 +0.07 L since last visit.
ACT score 18 (approaching well controlled). Technique checked: correct for budesonide-formoterol MDI. Smoking status unchanged.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Budesonide-formoterol increased to 400/12 mcg inhaler BD.
All other medications unchanged.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Chest X-ray PA: lungs show hyperinflated fields, flattened diaphragms, no focal consolidation, pleural effusion, or pneumothorax. Cardiac silhouette within normal limits. No acute rib fracture visualized.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
DEXA lumbar spine T-score -2.1 (osteoporotic range).
Serum calcium 9.4 mg/dL (8.5-10.5).
Serum 25-OH vitamin D 28 ng/mL (30-100) – still borderline low.
TSH 2.6 mIU/L (0.4-4.5).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling more tired lately and my shortness of breath feels worse when I climb stairs. Also my mood has dipped again; I’ve been having trouble sleeping.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Patient notes increased exertional dyspnea, low mood, and poor sleep.
Exam: SpO2 93%, scattered wheezes, mild pursed-lip breathing; affect depressed, psychomotor retardation mild.
Spirometry: FEV1 1.32 L (53% pred), FVC 2.38 L, FEV1/FVC 0.55; ΔFEV1 –0.13 L since last visit.
ACT score 14 (not well controlled). Technique checked: incorrect – patient not coordinating MDI puff; re‑taught slow inhalation and breath‑hold. Smoking status unchanged.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Sertraline discontinued.
Escitalopram 10 mg PO OD started.
Mirtazapine 15 mg PO HS added for sleep.
Inhaler regimen: tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS, budesonide-formoterol 400/12 mcg BD unchanged.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
PHQ-9 score 12 (moderate depression).
TSH 2.9 mIU/L (0.4-4.5).
Vitamin B12 310 pg/mL (200-900).

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment rescheduled from 2025-09-03 to 2025-09-03 at 14:00 due to clinic scheduling change.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Patient reports easier breathing on exertion, better sleep, mood improved.
Exam: SpO2 96%, mild wheeze only at lung bases, no pursed‑lip breathing; affect normal.
Spirometry: FEV1 1.48 L (59% pred), FVC 2.52 L, FEV1/FVC 0.59; ΔFEV1 +0.16 L since 07‑12 visit.
ACT score 22 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct for both inhalers. Smoking status unchanged.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Budesonide-formoterol reduced to 200/6 mcg inhaler BD.
Ti​otropium OD and salbutamol SOS unchanged.
Escitalopram 10 mg OD continued.
Mirtazapine 15 mg HS continued.
Alendronate, calcium/vitamin D unchanged.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Pulse oximetry at rest: SpO2 96% on room air. No desaturation on 6‑minute walk test (minimum 94%).

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Repeat spirometry: FEV1 1.50 L (60% pred), FVC 2.55 L, FEV1/FVC 0.59; ΔFEV1 +0.02 L since 09‑03 visit.
DEXA hip T-score -1.8 (osteopenia).
Serum calcium 9.5 mg/dL (8.5-10.5).
Serum 25-OH vitamin D 32 ng/mL (30-100) – sufficient.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Patient stable: reports mild occasional dyspnea only on heavy exertion, good sleep, mood steady.
Exam: SpO2 97%, clear lungs, no wheeze; cardiovascular normal; no vertebral tenderness.
Spirometry: FEV1 1.52 L (61% pred), FVC 2.58 L, FEV1/FVC 0.59; ΔFEV1 +0.02 L since last spirometry.
ACT score 24 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking status: former, 22 pack-years, stopped 2010.
Plan: continue current regimen, repeat DEXA in 1 year.
